mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% (UNRATE) signals labor market deterioration and economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signals strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a slowdown in industrial production (INDPRO falling below its 3-month moving average) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when the economy is in a late-cycle expansion and INDPRO falls below its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the consumer price index above 3.0% (CPIAUCSL) signals inflationary pressure that triggers monetary tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly growth in real GDP (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in the labor market (PAYEMS rising above its 3-month moving average) and consumer spending (RSAFS rising above its 3-month moving average) signals a virtuous cycle of economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both PAYEMS and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1600 thousand units (HOUST) signals weak housing market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST falls below 1600.
